features: Local Taste Engine: Offline, account-free algorithmic recommendation engine with skip tracking and taste mix generation
Local Taste Engine (Slice 2): Multi-source Last.fm recommendation pipeline (similar tracks, similar artists, top genres) with 1-hour taste snapshot caching and additive scoring bonuses
Local Taste Engine (Slice 3): Genre awareness with additive scoring bonus (+1.0), YouTube taste signals extraction, cross-screen generation status synchronization, and 'From Taste' quick action
Share Lyrics as Video: Export selected lyrics (10s-60s / 1 min) as a high-quality video with trimmed audio, hardware-accelerated MediaCodec encoding, and real-time synchronized karaoke animation

Lyrics Video Export Enhancements: Kinetic smooth camera scrolling, dynamic ambient motion, equalizer frequency visualizer, real-time progress bar, and embedded video preview with direct Instagram Story, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp sharing

Muse Cloud Sync: Real-time bidirectional synchronization, automatic web backup restoration, and native YouTube Music track resolution (eliminating JioSaavn playback failures) for liked songs and custom playlists between Muse Web App and Android APK
bug_fixes: Fixed YouTube audio stream download throttling during lyrics snippet trimming
Fixed overlapping multiline lyrics text in video frame renderer
